description: One of a pair flanking the parade square of the Bouaké military air station, on the packed surface of the square itself with no taxiway or apron link. Recorded as preserved; two aircraft of matching size and planform are visible at this point on Esri 0.34 m imagery acquired 11 February 2025. Variant E follows aviationsmilitaires.net which records seven Alpha Jet E for Côte d'Ivoire.

The second of the pair on the Bouaké parade square, about 25 m from TU-VCB. Same evidence base as TU-VCB: preserved status plus two matching airframes on 11 February 2025 Esri imagery. These airframes predate the November 2004 French destruction of the active Ivorian fleet and were not part of it.

Third Bouaké Alpha Jet, sited separately about 120 m south-east of the parade-square pair on a kerbed and planted traffic island inside the base. Recorded as preserved; a white swept-planform airframe is visible on the island on 11 February 2025 Esri imagery.
